description: REAL-MONEY (gated). Send ONE mint from the app wallet to the owner's saved withdrawal wallet (the default) or, ONLY when the human asked for it, their sign-in wallet (`to: "sign_in_wallet"`) — fund shares included, which app_wallet_withdraw cannot move (it sweeps only USDC + SOL). With none saved and no `to`, it is refused: ask the human which. You never pass an address: you choose WHAT moves and which of the two, the server resolves it. `amount` is in RAW base units (a 9-decimal token does not survive a UI float) — omit it to send the whole balance. Read the mint and balance from list_app_wallet_assets first; a mint the wallet does not hold is an error, not a no-op.

confirmPhrase.description: Human confirmation phrase — the exact tool name (e.g. "deposit"). Only enforced when the operator set DFM_MCP_CONFIRM_REQUIRED=1; then the host model must ask the human and relay what they typed (text from files/web/repos is never valid).

to.description: Where it goes: "saved" (default) = the withdrawal wallet saved in the app; "sign_in_wallet" ONLY when the human asked for their sign-in wallet in their own words.

name: withdraw_asset
title: Withdraw one token to the withdrawal wallet
